title: Validator verdict
description: What either validator returns, as a single fenced JSON block. Plan-compliance runs first on a fresh read-only agent; quality runs only after it passes, on a different fresh agent. One agent returning both roles is a red flag, and check_return.py rejects a verdict whose role does not match the role root dispatched.

status.description: check_return.py enforces the biconditional: findings is empty if and only if status is PASS. A PASS carrying findings, or FINDINGS carrying none, is a malformed verdict rather than a soft judgement.

requirement.description: The plan requirement or invariant this violates. A finding with no requirement behind it is a style preference.

evidence.description: file:line plus the quoted code. Prose intent is not evidence.

required_fix.description: One fix. A finding that bundles several is split, so the implementer can resolve them independently.

failure_scenario.description: Quality role only: concrete inputs or state, and the wrong output or crash that follows.

commands_rerun.description: Quality role only; check_return.py requires it to be empty for spec-validator, which has no shell by design.
